            $null -ne $nameProperty -and [string]$nameProperty.Value -like "*$Pattern*"
        })
        $entry = $entries | Sort-Object {
            $versionProperty = $_.PSObject.Properties['DisplayVersion']
            if ($null -ne $versionProperty) { [string]$versionProperty.Value } else { '' }
        } -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($null -ne $entry) {
            $versionProperty = $entry.PSObject.Properties['DisplayVersion']
            if ($null -ne $versionProperty -and $versionProperty.Value) { return [string]$versionProperty.Value }
            return 'Installee'
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Log ("Version non lisible pour {0}, poursuite de l'installation." -f $Pattern) 'ATTENTION'
    }
    return '-'
}

function Get-AppCacheDirectory($app) {
    $safeId = ([string]$app.Id -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_')
    return Join-Path $script:OfflineAppDir $safeId
}

function Get-CachedInstaller($app) {
    $folder = Get-AppCacheDirectory $app
    if (-not (Test-Path $folder)) { return $null }
    return Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $folder -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/]_nouveau-' -and $_.Extension -in @('.msi','.exe','.msix','.msixbundle','.appx','.appxbundle') } |
        Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Get-CachedInstallerLocale($app) {
    $localeFile = Join-Path (Get-AppCacheDirectory $app) 'SENETECH-Langue.txt'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $localeFile) {
        $value = Get-Content -LiteralPath $localeFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($value) { return [string]$value }
    }
    return 'Automatique'
}

function Update-OfflineStatus {
    $cached = 0
    foreach ($app in $appMap.Values) { if ($null -ne (Get-CachedInstaller ([pscustomobject]$app))) { $cached++ } }
    $drivers = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $script:OfflineDriverDir -Filter '*.inf' -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
    $script:OfflineStatusText.Text = "$cached application(s) en cache | $drivers pilote(s) INF"
}

function Get-CachedApps {
    $cachedApps = @()
    foreach ($app in $appMap.Values) {
        $candidate = [pscustomobject]$app
        if ($null -ne (Get-CachedInstaller $candidate)) { $cachedApps += $candidate }
    }
    return @($cachedApps)
}

function Invoke-AutoCacheUpdate {
    if ($script:AutoCacheCheck.IsChecked -ne $true -or -not (Test-Internet)) { return }
    $cachedApps = @(Get-CachedApps)
    if ($cachedApps.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Log 'Internet detecte, mais le cache est vide. Utilisez une premiere fois le bouton de telechargement.'
        return
    }
    try {
        Set-ControlsEnabled $false
        Set-Progress 10 'Mise a jour automatique du cache USB'
        Write-Log ("Internet detecte : actualisation de {0} application(s) deja en cache." -f $cachedApps.Count)
        Save-AppsForOffline $cachedApps
        Set-Progress 100 'Cache USB actualise'
        Write-Log 'Actualisation automatique du cache terminee.' 'OK'
    } catch {
        Write-Log ("Actualisation automatique impossible : {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) 'ATTENTION'
    } finally { Set-ControlsEnabled $true }
}

function Save-AppsForOffline($apps) {
    $winget = Get-Command winget.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $winget) { throw 'WinGet est introuvable. Ouvrez Microsoft Store, mettez a jour App Installer, puis relancez SENETECH.' }
    if (-not (Test-Internet)) { throw 'Internet est necessaire pour preparer le cache hors ligne.' }
    if ($apps.Count -eq 0) { throw 'Selectionnez au moins une application a mettre en cache.' }

    $locale = Get-PreferredLocale
    Write-Log ("Langue preferee des installateurs : {0}" -f $locale)
    $index = 0
    foreach ($app in $apps) {
        $index++
        $folder = Get-AppCacheDirectory $app
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $folder | Out-Null
        $staging = Join-Path $folder ("_nouveau-{0}-{1}" -f $script:SessionStamp, $index)
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $staging | Out-Null
        $downloadLocale = $locale
        Write-Log ("Telechargement hors ligne de {0} ({1}/{2})..." -f $app.Name, $index, $apps.Count)
        $arguments = @('download','--id',$app.Id,'--exact','--architecture',(Get-AppArchitecture),'--locale',$locale,'--download-directory',('"' + $staging + '"'),
          '--skip-license','--accept-package-agreements','--accept-source-agreements','--disable-interactivity')
        $code = Invoke-ProcessVisible -FilePath $winget.Source -Arguments $arguments
        if ($code -ne 0) {
            Write-Log ("Version {0} indisponible pour {1}, nouvel essai avec la langue par defaut de l'editeur." -f $locale, $app.Name) 'ATTENTION'
            $downloadLocale = 'Editeur / automatique'
            $arguments = @('download','--id',$app.Id,'--exact','--architecture',(Get-AppArchitecture),'--download-directory',('"' + $staging + '"'),
              '--skip-license','--accept-package-agreements','--accept-source-agreements','--disable-interactivity')
            $code = Invoke-ProcessVisible -FilePath $winget.Source -Arguments $arguments
        }
        $newInstaller = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $staging -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.Extension -in @('.msi','.exe','.msix','.msixbundle','.appx','.appxbundle') } |
            Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($code -eq 0 -and $null -ne $newInstaller) {
            # Une application = une seule version en cache. Une fois le nouveau
            # telechargement valide, on retire l'ancien contenu avant de promouvoir
            # la nouvelle version. Le dossier de staging est evidemment conserve.
            Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $folder -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $staging } |
                Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $staging -Force | Move-Item -Destination $folder -Force
            Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $folder 'SENETECH-Langue.txt') -Value $downloadLocale -Encoding UTF8
            Write-Log ("Cache actualise : {0} (ancienne version supprimee)" -f $newInstaller.Name) 'OK'
        } elseif ($null -ne (Get-CachedInstaller $app)) {
            Write-Log ("Telechargement impossible, ancien installateur conserve pour {0}." -f $app.Name) 'ATTENTION'
        } else {
            Write-Log ("Impossible de mettre {0} en cache (code {1})." -f $app.Name, $code) 'ATTENTION'
        }
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $staging) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Recurse -Force }
    }
    Update-OfflineStatus
}

function Invoke-OfflineInstaller($app, $installer) {
    $extension = $installer.Extension.ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($extension -eq '.msi') {
        return Invoke-ProcessVisible -FilePath 'msiexec.exe' -Arguments @('/i',('"' + $installer.FullName + '"'),'/qn','/norestart')
    }
    if ($extension -in @('.msix','.msixbundle','.appx','.appxbundle')) {
        try { Add-AppxPackage -Path $installer.FullName -ForceApplicationShutdown; return 0 }
        catch { Write-Log $_.Exception.Message 'ATTENTION'; return 1 }
    }

    $silent = switch ($app.Id) {
        'Google.Chrome' { @('/silent','/install') }
        'Mozilla.Firefox' { @('/S') }
        '7zip.7zip' { @('/S') }
        'VideoLAN.VLC' { @('/S') }
        { $_ -in @('Adobe.Acrobat.Reader.64-bit','Adobe.Acrobat.Reader.32-bit') } { @('/sAll','/rs','/rps','/msi','EULA_ACCEPT=YES'); break }
        'TheDocumentFoundation.LibreOffice' { @('/S') }
        'Zoom.Zoom' { @('/silent') }
        'Discord.Discord' { @('-s') }
        'Valve.Steam' { @('/S') }
        'EpicGames.EpicGamesLauncher' { @('/quiet','/norestart') }
        'ElectronicArts.EADesktop' { @('/silent') }
        'Ubisoft.Connect' { @('/S') }
        'Blizzard.BattleNet' { @('/S') }
        'GOG.Galaxy' { @('/VERYSILENT','/NORESTART') }
        'OBSProject.OBSStudio' { @('/S') }
        { $_ -in @('Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64','Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x86') } { @('/install','/quiet','/norestart'); break }
        'Microsoft.DirectX' { @('/Q') }
        'Nvidia.NVIDIAApp' { @('-s') }
        'Intel.IntelDriverAndSupportAssistant' { @('-s') }
        default { @('/S') }
    }
    return Invoke-ProcessVisible -FilePath $installer.FullName -Arguments $silent
}

function Install-SelectedApps($apps) {
    $online = Test-Internet
    $winget = Get-Command winget.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $useWinget = $online -and $null -ne $winget
    if ($online -and -not $winget) { Write-Log 'WinGet est absent : utilisation du cache USB disponible.' 'ATTENTION' }

    $locale = Get-PreferredLocale
    Write-Log ("Langue Windows detectee pour les applications : {0}" -f $locale)
    $index = 0
    $results = @()
    foreach ($app in $apps) {
        $index++
